Starbucks Sued Over Allegedly Misleading 'Sugar-Free' Drinks

Starbucks is facing a lawsuit alleging that some of its "sugar-free" beverages contain significant amounts of sugar. The lawsuit claims that certain drinks marketed as sugar-free actually contain as much sugar as a KitKat candy bar. The case centers on the alleged mislabeling of these drinks.
